web_evidence.title: The Story of Edgar Sawtelle — authorized excerpt, page 6
web_evidence.note: Publisher-permission excerpt sustains external narration of family history and Edgar's imagined reconstruction of Schultz's life. Supports the opening portion, not independently the whole book.

web_evidence.title: David Wroblewski Writing Styles in The Story of Edgar Sawtelle
web_evidence.note: Explicitly identifies third-person omniscient narration throughout, with perspectives shifting among Edgar, Trudy, Claude, and Almondine.

web_evidence.title: A Canine-Centric Critique of Selected Dog Narratives
web_evidence.note: Scholarly discussion of Almondine's focalization, especially printed pages 42 and 107–108, reproduces third-person passages from early and late in the novel. Supports interpreting canine perspective as focalization rather than first-person narration.

person_note: A nonparticipating third-person narrator moves among human and canine perspectives. Sustained Goodreads scenes agree with the authorized excerpt, scholarly discussion of Almondine's sections, and explicit whole-book description. Dialogue and generic you reflections do not establish other base persons; q01673 is identifiable speech through matching input passages. The remaining uncertainty is the precise local attribution of q01678, which remains unclear rather than being promoted to first-person base narration. No credible evidence establishes sustained mixed-person sections.
